name: Ancient Building Complex in the Wudang Mountains
description: In the forested valleys and ridges of Hubei Province, the Wudang Mountains hold a sprawling web of Taoist temples, palaces and monasteries. Most were organized into a grand complex under the Ming dynasty, though some buildings date back to the 7th century. Revered as a Taoist sacred mountain and a famed home of tai chi, Wudang draws pilgrims and martial artists alike.
